blind.description: An interior wall section featuring an open doorway with a wooden frame and wainscoting. The upper portion of the wall is painted a light cream/beige plaster texture, while the lower base features carved brown wooden wainscot panels with decorative molding. A thick dark wood door frame surrounds the rectangular doorway opening. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or holes. The model rests flat on the ground on its two base pillars without an added base plinth.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular block shape running horizontally across the view, showing the flat cream-colored top of the wall section and slight projections of the wooden moldings on both sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: It stands about 1.4 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 8 feet tall), and is about as wide as the figure is tall (around 5.5 to 6 feet wide).
